name: Intrinsic Color Decomposition Network
definition: A color network design that disentangles color-shape ambiguities by predicting separate albedo (view-invariant) and shading (view-dependent) components, summed to produce the final color.
summary: The Intrinsic Color Decomposition Network disentangles color-shape ambiguities by predicting separate view-invariant albedo and view-dependent shading components to improve novel view synthesis extrapolation.
